department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 9, 2026, 11:59 pm Pacific (Fall entry only).

also.quote: the application deadline is December 9 by 11:59 pm Pacific Time (PST)

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required but is highly encouraged for Ph.D. applicants.
gre_general.quote: Students who wish to apply for admission to our graduate program are not required to take the GRE or submit a GRE score report as part of their application package, however, it is highly encouraged for PhD applicants.

fee_waiver.value: International applicants cannot get an application fee waiver.
fee_waiver.quote: International applicants are NOT eligible for fee waivers.

ielts_min.quote: Minimum IELTS overall score requirement is a 7.0.

english_waiver.value: Only degrees from countries where English is both the primary spoken language of daily life and the medium of instruction are exempt, so an Indian degree does not waive the test.
english_waiver.quote: International Applicants who hold a bachelor’s or higher degree from a university located in the United States or in another country in which English is both the primary spoken language of daily life (e.g., Australia, Barbados, Canada, Ireland, Jamaica, New Zealand, United Kingdom) AND the medium of instruction

supervisor.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

funding.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

entry_route.value: Apply to the Ph.D. with a B.S. in materials science or a comparable major (GPA 3.25/4.0); a master's is normally not required.
entry_route.quote: To apply for the Ph.D. degree, applicants should have a B.S. in Materials Science and Engineering or a comparable major with a GPA of not less than 3.25/4.0 in undergraduate study.

also.quote: Normally the M.S. degree is not required for admission to the Ph.D. program.
